what_to_detect: A monstrosity N resolution on a permanent that is not monstrous puts N +1/+1 counters on it (counter_change events).
near_miss: A monstrosity resolution on a permanent already monstrous puts no counter.
record_fields: sidecar acting line: script_api_type and script_param_keys (Monstrosity$)

what_to_detect: A monstrosity N resolution puts N +1/+1 counters, not one, on a permanent that is not monstrous. The counters show only in a resolution record's counter_change events; a continuous record shows only the monstrous-gated static's contribution, which is the same whatever N was and is also present when the permanent was already monstrous.
near_miss: A monstrosity resolution on a permanent already monstrous puts no counter.

what_to_detect: A monstrosity X resolution on a permanent that is not monstrous puts X +1/+1 counters on it, the X its other abilities then use.
near_miss: A monstrosity resolution on a permanent already monstrous puts no counter and does not make it monstrous again.

what_to_detect: A monstrosity resolution puts its counters on a permanent that was monstrous, left the battlefield and returned: the returned permanent is a new object and not monstrous.
near_miss: A monstrosity resolution on a permanent that stayed monstrous on the battlefield puts no counter.
